record.paper_title: Open problems for the superKdV equations
record.original_question: Can Darboux transformations and corresponding solution-generating techniques be developed for the N = 2 super KdV equations, extending the existing N = 1 Darboux-transformation results to the N = 2 setting where the paper states that no such work had yet been done?

evidence.quote: Moreover, little is known concerning the solutions of super integrable systems. The Darboux transformation in the N = 1 case has been worked out in [21] but nothing has been done at this point concerning the N = 2 cases.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the N=2 supersymmetric extensions of the Korteweg–de Vries (KdV) equation. In the N=2 setting one works over a Grassmann algebra with two odd coordinates θ₁, θ₂ and the superspace covariant derivatives D_i = ∂/∂θ_i + θ_i ∂_x (i=1,2). The N=2 super KdV equations form a one-parameter family (commonly indexed by a parameter a ∈ {−2, 1, 4}) of integrable evolution equations for an N=2 bosonic superfield Φ(x,t,θ₁,θ₂), each of which admits a Lax representation and an infinite hierarchy of conserved quantities.

Develop a theory of Darboux transformations for the N=2 super KdV equations: explicitly construct gauge/Darboux transformations of their Lax operators that map solutions to new solutions, derive the associated Bäcklund transformations and nonlinear superposition (permutability) formulas, and use these to produce solution-generating techniques (e.g., soliton-type solutions and discretizations) for each integrable case a = −2, 1, 4 of the N=2 super KdV hierarchy.
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work has constructed Darboux/Bäcklund transformations for N=2 super KdV equations, at least in specific integrable cases. In particular, Bäcklund–Darboux transformations and discretizations were obtained for the N=2, a=−2 supersymmetric KdV equation (Liu–Xie 2017), and related Darboux transformations have been developed for the sl(2|1) super KdV hierarchy and other super KdV-type equations (e.g., a SIGMA 2025 paper on Bäcklund–Darboux transformations for super KdV-type equations). Hence the original question has been addressed in part, though a fully unified treatment covering all N=2 cases (a = −2, 1, 4) is not yet completely settled.

status_evidence.title: Bäcklund–Darboux transformations and discretizations of N=2 a=−2 supersymmetric KdV equation
status_evidence.snippet: Darboux and Bäcklund transformation constructed via gauge transformation for the N=2 a=−2 SUSY KdV; nonlinear superposition formula and discretizations derived.
status_evidence.claim: Darboux transformations have been constructed for the N=2 a=−2 super KdV equation.

status_evidence.title: Bäcklund-Darboux Transformations for Super KdV Type Equations (SIGMA 2025)
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work develops Bäcklund–Darboux transformations for super KdV-type equations.
status_evidence.claim: Further development of Darboux transformations for super KdV-type equations continues into 2025.

status_evidence.title: A Darboux transformation of the sl(2|1) super KdV hierarchy and a super lattice potential KdV equation
status_evidence.snippet: Darboux transformation derived for the sl(2|1) super KdV hierarchy, yielding super lattice potential KdV.
status_evidence.claim: Darboux transformations have been derived for an N=2-related super KdV hierarchy.
